mechanism.baseline_network_policy: networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicy selects app=clayverse with policyTypes Ingress+Egress and empty ingress/egress rule sets
mechanism.functional_networking: separate deployment-specific reviewed allow policy only
mechanism.cni_enforcement: must be observed; API-object presence alone is not runtime evidence
mechanism.node_local_boundary: node/control-plane/metadata reachability must be separately fenced and tested; standard NetworkPolicy is not treated as sufficient
mechanism.microvm_boundary: independent guest-kernel isolation remains mandatory and is not replaced by NetworkPolicy

primary_external_basis: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy API/concept documentation: pods are non-isolated by default until selected by policy; empty ingress/egress with both policyTypes is a default-deny pattern
Kubernetes documentation: network plugin/CNI must implement NetworkPolicy for the object to have effect
Kubernetes documentation: traffic to/from the node where a pod runs is a NetworkPolicy exception and must not be silently assumed denied

isolated_exact_file_evidence.source_binding: git hash-object matched all three GitHub target blobs exactly

strongest_counterhypothesis.claim: A syntactically correct default-deny NetworkPolicy can provide zero isolation if the admitted CNI does not enforce it, and node-local/control-plane/metadata paths can remain reachable despite the policy.
strongest_counterhypothesis.cheapest_next_falsifier: On the final admitted Kata/equivalent cluster, bind CNI/runtime/image identities, prove default-deny empirically from independent ingress and egress probes, probe node-local/metadata/control-plane paths, then apply the exact reviewed allow policy and show only admitted flows open.

go_unusual_experiment.reason: No shared immutable request/turn id is exposed and the exact user-message timestamp available to this organ has minute precision only; the current atomic lease protocol forbids a timestamp fallback.
